minutes.summary: The Select Board made Council on Aging appointments, approved a bank's reverse-toll event, and heard long public comment on Lake Shirley and the Conservation Commission. what_happened.line: The Select Board accepted a trash bag fee increase on a 4-1 vote, to cover higher costs in the solid waste enterprise fund.
The board approved an amendment to the Casella contract: recyclables charged per ton, the rebate removed, and education funds made automatic.
The board debated moving meetings out of Town Hall to an ADA-compliant location; the minutes record the vote on preparing a move as not audible.
Three Conservation Commission members came up for reappointment; one passed 4-1, one passed, and the third vote is not audible in the minutes.
Public comment on the Conservation Commission and the Lake Shirley program ran long, with speakers asking the board to oversee the commission.

why_it_matters: The bag fee increase and the new per-ton recycling terms change what households pay through the solid waste enterprise fund, which is funded by user fees rather than the general tax levy.
Where the board meets decides who can physically attend and take part in public meetings, and the outcome of that vote is not clear from the recording.
watch_next: The town manager evaluation review was moved to the July 9 meeting.
The minutes do not record the outcome of the vote on moving meetings, so a later meeting or the official minutes would need to confirm it.
